synopsis: Sam's warm practice invitation branches into so many options — day, time, food, drinks, tennis first or after — that nobody in the cafe can answer it. The learner helps him collapse the sprawl into one clear time-and-activity ask, and the class's first explicit consent beat lands when Sam issues that single invitation, hears a soft refusal, and honors it without re-asking.

forbiddenClaims: surname, guessed kana name, nationality, employer, or private history
asking a second time framed as persistence that works
surname, guessed kana name, nationality, job, or private history
a soft refusal framed as a confidence deficit

scenes.goal: Meet Sam through a warm invitation that branches into more options than anyone can answer, and reach the point where generosity has become paralysis.
scenes.dramaticQuestion: When an invitation has too many options, will adding one more make it answerable, or does it have to be narrowed to a single ask?
scenes.learnerNeed: A real invitation that must be collapsed from a sprawl of options into one clear time-and-activity ask.

nodes.description: The cafe's corner table already has glasses and a jug set out, poured before anyone agreed to anything. A notepad waits in the middle under Sam's pen.

nodes.intent: Warmly invite the whole class to a get-together, and to be inclusive, put every possible option on the table at once.
nodes.attentionTarget: the blank notepad and the class around the table

nodes.intent: Try to help by adding still more options — drinks, dessert — making the invitation even less answerable.
nodes.attentionTarget: the growing list on the notepad

nodes.description: The notepad fills with branching options — days, dishes, drinks, tennis-first-or-after — arrows crossing arrows. The poured drinks sit untouched, going flat. Nobody at the table answers.

nodes.intent: Notice, out loud, that the invitation has grown so branched that nobody can find a place to answer it.
nodes.attentionTarget: the thicket of options and the silent table

nodes.resume: The invitation has branched past the point of being answerable. The learner steps in to collapse it into one clear ask: a single opening time and one named activity.

nodes.resumeContext: The sprawl of options is on the notepad. The learner picks one day and one opening time, states it as a range (Saturday, from six), names a single activity (okonomiyaki), and phrases the whole thing as one clear invitation with 〜ませんか and an easy way to decline.

nodes.description: The extra branches fold away, leaving a single card with a time slot and an activity slot. Only the phrasing chunk that went missing — the time range or the invitation ending — returns for another try; the chosen day and activity stay put.

nodes.resume: One clear invitation now sits on the card: Saturday, from six, okonomiyaki, with room to say no. Sam looks at it.

nodes.intent: Realize that narrowing to a single askable choice, rather than adding more options, is what makes the invitation answerable.

foundation.japanese: あ…そうか。一つで いいんだ。土曜日の 六時から、おこのみやきを たべませんか。これなら、こたえられますね。

n1.japanese: なるほどねえ…あれもこれもと足していくより、いっそ一つに絞ってしまったほうが、よっぽど答えやすいわけだ。「土曜の六時から、うちでおこのみやきでもどうですか」。……うん、これでいい。これなら相手も、一言で返せる。
n1.reading: なるほどねえ…あれもこれもとたしていくより、いっそひとつにしぼってしまったほうが、よっぽどこたえやすいわけだ。「どようのろくじから、うちでおこのみやきでもどうですか」。……うん、これでいい。これならあいても、ひとことでかえせる。
n1.english: Ah, I see... rather than piling on this and that, just narrowing it down to one is far easier to answer, isn't it. "From six on Saturday, how about okonomiyaki at my place?" ...Yeah, that's it. Like this, the other person can answer in a single word too.

scenes.goal: Let Sam issue the single clear invitation, hear a real answer, and honor a soft refusal without re-asking.
scenes.dramaticQuestion: When the one clear invitation gets a soft 'no,' will Sam add another option to change it, or accept the answer he asked for?
scenes.learnerNeed: A stance on how to help Sam receive a hedged refusal as a complete answer and keep the door open.

nodes.description: On the cleared notepad, one line remains: Saturday, from six, okonomiyaki. Every other branch has been set aside. The card can finally be answered.

nodes.intent: Issue the one clear invitation aloud, once, with an easy, built-in way to decline.
nodes.attentionTarget: the single invitation card and the person across the table

foundation.japanese: じゃあ、聞きますね。土曜日の 六時から、おこのみやきを たべませんか。むりなら、「また こんど」でも いいですよ。
foundation.reading: じゃあ、ききますね。どようびの ろくじから、おこのみやきを たべませんか。むりなら、「また こんど」でも いいですよ。
foundation.english: Okay, I'll ask. From six on Saturday, shall we eat okonomiyaki? If you can't, "another time" is completely fine.

n5.japanese: じゃあ、一回だけ 聞きますね。土曜日の 六時から、うちで おこのみやきを 食べませんか。来られない ときは、「また こんど」で いいですよ。

nodes.intent: Warmly decline this one time with a hedged, indirect refusal that still clearly means no, and leave the relationship open.
nodes.attentionTarget: the invitation card he is answering

nodes.description: One clear invitation, one honored answer. The Saturday card stays out on the table for whoever's free; the flat drinks are cleared and fresh ones poured for the people who are here now.

callbacks.meaningNow: An invitation contains so many options that nobody can answer it clearly — generosity becomes paralysis until it is narrowed to one askable choice.
callbacks.optionalFallback: Sam's invitation simply has too many parts, and the class trims it to a single time-and-activity ask.

outcomes.description: Sam's over-optioned invitation is collapsed into one clear time-and-activity ask, and the class's first explicit consent beat lands as a soft refusal that is heard and honored without a re-ask.

Sam is introduced through a warm, over-branching invitation and takes his first step from inclusion-as-more-options toward asking once and honoring the answer; his generous open-door welcome is established as a competence the class can rely on later.
State-an-opening-and-a-clear-invitation-and-honor-a-soft-refusal evidence returns through the registered transfer activity; the story emits no lesson-completion command.

replay.withdrawnContentFallback: Use the same narrow-to-one-invitation and honor-a-soft-refusal beats with neutral nameplates and a generic host who collapses an over-optioned plan into one time-and-activity ask and accepts a hedged decline.
